title: How to check if a cell contains any word from a list
task: Flag rows whose text includes any of several keywords — banned words, categories, tags to match.
keywords: if cell contains one of many values excel

excel.note: D2:D4 = the list of words, A2 = the text. Returns TRUE if any word is found (case-insensitive).

explanation: SEARCH looks for each word from the list inside the cell and returns a position number when found or an error when not; ISNUMBER turns those into TRUE/FALSE, the -- converts to 1/0, and SUMPRODUCT adds them — a total above 0 means at least one word matched. "large red widget" contains "widget" (from the list), so the result is TRUE. SEARCH is case-insensitive; swap it for FIND to match case. To return WHICH word matched, wrap in a lookup; to count HOW MANY matched, drop the >0 and keep the SUMPRODUCT. This is the array-powered version of stacking many ISNUMBER(SEARCH(...)) tests with OR.
